caption:
Real strength shows up when you are angry.

The Prophet ﷺ said that the strong one is not the person who overpowers others, but the one who keeps control of himself in anger. That is a kind of strength anyone can work on.

Sahih al-Bukhari 6114 · Grade: Sahih

Send this to the friend who always keeps you calm.

#hadith #anger #selfcontrol #islamicreels
alt_text: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger (Sahih al-Bukhari 6114)
